1479-2841-6158-8338.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Blighted Woodland.
1479-2841-6158-8338.description:
Fetch a land using Blighted Woodland.
When the fetched land enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1981-5147-6097.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
1981-5147-6097.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing any other creature you control, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2558-4186-6689-8095-8181.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, Golbez triggers.
Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.
Resolve the Golbez trigger, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Squirrel.
Repeat from step 2.

5254-6627-8095.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
5254-6627-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat.

2034-5254-6627.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.

1981-2415-2842-4247.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Blood Artist and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-5982-6965.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5982-6965.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Ancient Gold Dragon, triggering Breath of Fury and Ancient Gold Dragon.
Resolve the Ancient Gold Dragon trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 5 or greater

3464-3657-7704.description:
Activate Doc Samson by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Doc Samson.
Activate Kogla by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

141-413-3125.notablePrerequisites: You have two creature cards in your graveyard.
141-413-3125.description:
Cast Victimize by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Naru Meha targeting Victimize.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Victimize
Resolve the Victimize copy, sacrificing a creature and returning Naru Meha and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2921-4535--5.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat

765-1558-2638-4231-4772.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
765-1558-2638-4231-4772.description:
Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Doubling Season.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1636-5627-7201.notablePrerequisites:
Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
1636-5627-7201.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Sapling Nursery triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2700-5256-6972.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Arcbound Shikari.
When Arcbound Shikari dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Shikari's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Shikari from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3165-3532-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
392-3165-3532-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Birgi and Managorger Hydra trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Managorger Hydra trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2921-7083-7084.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, it and Baloth Prime trigger.
Resolve the land's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Baloth Prime trigger, untapping it and creating a tapped 4/4 Beast creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

671-2034-3490-4017.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
671-2034-3490-4017.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

1978-4324-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that share a creature type.
1978-4324-7013.description:
Animate White Lotus Tile using Workshop Elders.
Activate White Lotus Tile by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping White Lotus Tile.
Repeat from step 2.

222-527-3967-6968.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-3967-6968.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1978-2392-5704.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with power 4 or greater.
1978-2392-5704.description:
Activate Leafkin Avenger by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Leafkin Avenger.
Repeat

1492-4195-4574-6900.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
Gwenom has attacked this turn.
1492-4195-4574-6900.description:
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Resolve the Welding Jar ability.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Welding Jar from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Welding Jar from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1718-3327-4613-6602.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1718-3327-4613-6602.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Tromell.
Activate Dargo using Catalyst Elemental's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

1322-1563-2351-6460.easyPrerequisites:
You control a token.
It is an opponent's turn.
1322-1563-2351-6460.description:
Activate Hardened Tactician by paying {1} and sacrificing a token.
If you sacrificed a Tentacle, The Watcher's second ability triggers if the creature token was a Tentacle, untapping a Kraken and putting a stun counter on up to one nonland permanent.
Resolve the Hardened Tactician ability, causing you to draw a card.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate the Tentacle by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

4659-4758-4853-4888.description:
Activate Puppet's Conjurer by paying {U} and tapping it, creating a 0/1 Homunculus artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Homunculus, adding {C}{C}.
When the Homunculus dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Puppet's Conjurer.
Activate Crossroads Candleguide by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Repeat.

1987-2239-3277-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-2239-3277-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Ardent Elementalist and Izzet Chronarch.
When Ardent Elementalist and Izzet Chronarch enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2239-3277-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

38-2420-4802.notablePrerequisites: Scuzzback Marauders does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
38-2420-4802.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Scuzzback Marauders, adding {R}.
When Scuzzback Marauders dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Repeat.

465-3742-4251-4359-5929.notablePrerequisites: Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-3742-4251-4359-5929.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

2793-3743-4365-5089-5636.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2793-3743-4365-5089-5636.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Psychic Frog by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

1069-3552-4885-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-3552-4885-5499.description:
Activate Blaring Recruiter by paying {2}{W}, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Warrior.
Activate the Warrior by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.

1339-4279-5870.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
1339-4279-5870.description:
Activate Yawgmoth's first ability by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, causing you to draw a card and allowing you to put a -1/-1 counter on up to one creature.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and get {E}.
Repeat.

204-3940-5851.manaNeeded: {8} at most, depending on how many Stormsplitters and/or other creatures you control without summoning sickness
204-3940-5851.notablePrerequisites: Sorcerer Class is at least level 2.
204-3940-5851.description:
Activate any creature you control that does not have summoning sickness by tapping it, adding {R} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat step 1 until you control no untapped creatures without summoning sickness, or until you have {3}{R} available, whichever comes first.
Cast Haze of Rage with buyback by paying {3}{R}.
Haze of Rage's storm ability triggers, each Stormsplitter you control triggers, and Sorcerer Class's third ability triggers if it is level 3.
Resolve the Stormsplitter triggers, creating that many token copies of Stormsplitter.
Resolve the Sorcerer Class trigger, if applicable, dealing damage to any target equal to the number of instant and/or sorcery spells you've cast this turn.
Resolve the Haze of Rage trigger, copying it for each spell you've cast before it this turn.
Resolve all Haze of Rages, causing creatures you control to get +1/+0 for each Haze of Rage, and returning the original Haze of Rage to your hand.
Repeat.

4311-5033-5078-5679.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
4311-5033-5078-5679.description:
Activate a land that enters the battlefield untapped by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Storm Cauldron triggers, returning the land from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Kellan triggers, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

1636-4183.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {U}{R}.
1636-4183.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {U}{R}.
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of another creature you control with haste.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{U}{R}, this combo nets infinite mana.

719-1849-3259-4302.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
"Angel" chosen with Xenograft.
719-1849-3259-4302.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to any other creature you control, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the creature that had Breath of Fury attached dies as an Angel due to Xenograft, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Xenograft, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat each combat phase.

1967-2440-4055.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Goblins.
1967-2440-4055.description:
Activate Ardoz by paying {3}{R}, creating a 1/1 Goblin creature token with haste.
The Goblin enters the battlefield, triggering Ardoz and Mana Echoes.
Resolve the Ardoz trigger, giving the Goblin +2/+0 until end of turn.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Goblin you control.
Activate Energy Refractor by paying {2}, adding {R}.
Repeat.

565-2450-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {2}{U}, targeting Gilded Lotus.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a copy of Gilded Lotus.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, changing nothing and returning it to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-4112-4242-4499.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding {C}{C}.
Su-Chi triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Sharuum.
Sharuum enters the battlefield, returning Su-Chi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

312-2034-4875-5189.notablePrerequisites:
A creature you control has a +1/+1 counter on it.
"Zombie" chosen with Conspiracy.
312-2034-4875-5189.description:
Activate Ghave by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control to create a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Champion of the Perished triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

190-1068.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Leveler and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
When each opponent's Leveler enters the battlefield, they trigger, exiling each opponent's library.

269-1494-2030.notablePrerequisites: Sage of Hours has the lowest toughness or is tied for the lowest toughness among creatures you control.
269-1494-2030.description:
Cast Sandsteppe Mastodon by paying {5}{G}{G}.
Sandsteppe Mastodon enters the battlefield, putting five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the begging of your upkeep, Roaring Primadox triggers, causing you to return Sandsteppe Mastodon from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3181-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Krosan Restorer.
You control up to three lands that can produce a total of {1}{U} or more.
At least seven cards in your graveyard.
Krosan Restorer does not have summoning sickness.
3181-4222.description:
Activate Krosan Restorer's last ability by tapping it, untapping up to three lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Krosan Restorer.
Repeat.

364-813-1987-3448.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Stadium Vendors and Scholar of the Ages, blinking them.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Stadium Vendors enters the battlefield, add {U}{U}.
Repeat.
